verdict.summary: Round 3 finds no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. The content-based exemption remains restricted to the audited `.github/feature-matrix.d/` tree; all other `.github/**` YAML, including workflows with raw-text consumers, still fails closed to the full matrix. Revision/blob/parser/parse uncertainty also fails closed. Parsed-document comparison is type-tagged and order-aware where semantics require it, and the tests cover the real selection path, PyYAML comment and block-scalar behavior, behavior-changing edits, allowlist boundaries, consumer-audit drift, and a mutation check. The focused test classes pass in this checkout (28 tests, with 6 real-PyYAML cases skipped because the optional dependency is absent), while CI installs the hash-pinned dependency best-effort so absence affects precision only. Findings are materially unchanged from round 2: none remain.
